name: Scenario 2: Faulty Release Rollout (v2.0.0)
incident_prompt: Payment service transactions are failing with 100% 500 Internal Server Error following release.

ground_truth.root_cause: Application regression introduced in release v2.0.0 of payment-service: unhandled NullPointerException in ChargeHandler during payment processing.
ground_truth.trigger: Deployment rollout of payment-service to image version v2.0.0.
symptoms: 100% 500 Internal Server Error rate on /charge endpoint immediately following rollout
Clean pod readiness but application-level fatal exceptions in container logs
